title: Subscription Cost Explorer
statement:
Build a calendar-year subscription cost explorer for a SaaS billing system. A customer may hold one or more product subscriptions across a target `year`, where each subscription starts in a given `YYYY-MM-DD` date, optionally ends on a given date (or continues indefinitely when `endDate == null`), and charges a fixed monthly price in cents.

Implement `monthlyCostReport(List<Subscription> subscriptions, int year)` returning an array `long[12]` where index `0` is January and index `11` is December of `year`, holding the total cost in cents across all active subscriptions for each month.

Contract
- `Subscription(String product, long monthlyPriceCents, String startDate, String endDate)`: `startDate` is always a valid `YYYY-MM-DD` date; `endDate` is either `null` (active through the end of time) or a valid `YYYY-MM-DD` date with `endDate >= startDate`.
- **Billing rule:** A subscription is billed for its full `monthlyPriceCents` in every calendar month `(year, month)` that overlaps its active interval `[startDate, endDate]` by at least one day (i.e., `startYearMonth <= (year, month)` and, if `endDate != null`, `(year, month) <= endYearMonth`).
- Multiple subscriptions (for the same or different products) sum independently.
- If `subscriptions` is empty or none overlap `year`, return 12 zeros.

Examples
- Single subscription `("Jira", 1000, "2025-03-15", null)` for `2025` -> `[0, 0, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000]`.
- Bounded + overlapping subscriptions: `("Jira", 1000, "2024-11-01", "2025-02-10")` and `("Confluence", 500, "2025-02-20", "2025-04-01")` for `2025` -> `[1000, 1500, 500, 500, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]`.
- Subscription outside target year: `("Jira", 1000, "2026-01-01", null)` for `2025` -> all zeros.
hints: Convert each YYYY-MM-DD date to an integer month index such as year * 12 + (month - 1) (or use java.time.YearMonth). Only the year and month matter for the billing rule.

For target year Y, the 12 calendar months span [Y * 12, Y * 12 + 11]. Clamp each subscription's active month range [startMonth, endMonth] (treating null endDate as Y * 12 + 11) to [Y * 12, Y * 12 + 11].

If the clamped start <= clamped end, add monthlyPriceCents to every month in [clampedStart - Y * 12, clampedEnd - Y * 12] (or use a 13-element difference array and prefix sum). Intended complexity: O(n) time, O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: year; product price start end|-, ..., for example: 2025; Jira 1000 2025-03-15 -, Confluence 500 2025-02-20 2025-04-01
